messages:
leah_sales: quick sync 3> prospect needs a 1-page artifact checklist to close POC. also asks if we can share full pen-test report and whether reserved pricing is required before POC. deadline: Tue.

dan_ps: Minimal artifacts we give for POCs: SOC2 Type II summary (pdf), pen-test attestation (signed), redacted exec summary of findings, staging network diagram, SSO test steps + test account, list of staging IPs or VPN details, and a short support runbook.

dan_ps: Reserved pricing not required. we can do a non-committed POC. if they want guaranteed latency we offer a short-term reserved window (priced separately).

priya_security: On pen-test sharing: we provide a signed attestation (redwood-attest v1.2) and a redacted findings summary by default. full/raw reports require NDA + secure dataroom access and legal sign-off. we do not share scanner logs or vendor creds.

priya_security: Our attestation template includes: test date, scope (external/internal), summary of critical/high findings, and remediation commitments for any high issues.

kai_ops: Staging IPs: default ephemeral CIDR for POC is 35.200.120.0/28 ingress and 35.200.120.16/30 callbacks. If they need static public IPs for a longer window, ops needs 3 business days and it may impact pricing.

leah_sales: can someone make a short checklist i can email? buyer asked: "is network diagram + SSO + pen-test attestation enough?"

dan_ps: yes, typically enough for signoff if attestation shows no open criticals and SSO is validated in staging. Suggested one-page checklist:
- SOC2 Type II attestation OR controls summary
- Pen-test attestation (signed) or redacted summary in dataroom
- Network / UAT architecture diagram
- SSO/SAML test user validated
- Staging IP whitelist or VPN details
- POC support hours + escalation contact

priya_security: I'll send the attestation template and can redline if their legal asks changes. If they request full report, we need NDA + contact for secure share.

leah_sales: thanks all 44D will send checklist and ask about redacted vs full. tagging you if they push on static IPs or reserved pricing.

kai_ops: ping me for the ops ticket if they want static IPs.
